title: Spicy Ackee Fritters
description: A Thai-inspired twist on traditional ackee fritters, with a spicy kick. Best served as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine ackee, hash, dried red chili flakes, and salt. Mix well.
2. Divide the mixture into 6-8 portions, depending on desired fritter size.
3. Shape each portion into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
4. Heat a non-stick skillet or frying pan over medium-high heat.
5. Add a small amount of oil to the pan and swirl to coat.
6. Add the fritters to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
7. Remove the fritters from the pan and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
8. Serve the fritters hot with vegan cheese shreds on top.
